114.news_title: 2nd Monitor for Your Vewlix, Chewlix and Game Wizard Xtreme Machines
114.long_description: Add a 2nd monitor to your Taito Vewlix, China made Chewlix or the Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme arcade cabinet series. Run your second monitor on your arcade cabinet to show game headers/marquee, game score or advertising. The 14.9inch LCD panel supports both VGA and HDMI input. With metal mounting frame and cables, this 14.9inch 2nd monitor is plug and play into original Vewlix, "true" clone Chewlix, or any version of the Game Wizard Xtreme arcade machines. Monitors are in stock and available for immediate shipment; Buy your 2nd monitor for your arcade machine here.
